newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds end firmer on position-squaring.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds end firmer on position-squaring.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Swiss franc bonds ended slightly higher in very quiet conditions with trading driven by banks' squaring their positions. Institutional and private investors absent.
* March Conf up five points to 116.12 percent
* Swiss gov's 4.50 pct bond 2007 yields 3.940 percent
